title: kbmon.py snapshot core and kb panel: --json and --once, per-panel timeouts, read-only and redacted
goal: python3 _tools/kbmon.py --json prints one JSON object of schema 1 with a panel for each of kb, coord, sessions, querylog, host, sprint and log, each with its state (ok, timeout, error, absent or unsupported) and seconds; --once prints the same panels as plain text with no escape byte; each panel runs in a daemon thread bounded by --timeout seconds, so a slow source shows timeout while the snapshot returns; the kb panel shows the roots with the articles and facts by tag that rag.py audit counts, open gaps and conflicts, the newest refresh and census dates, the last recorded lookup-eval result and the pack index age; a run builds no index, runs no eval and writes nothing in the clone, the query log home or _cache; every string of --json and --once passes redact.redact, also for a saved snapshot read with --from-snapshot FILE

ask: Does the Python interpreter wait at exit for a ThreadPoolExecutor's worker threads, and does a daemon thread let it exit?

notes: Plan 2026-10-18: new capability, so every check fails on origin/main 423d72d05 for want of _tools/kbmon.py (precheck). Contract the later items' checks read: kbmon.main(argv) returns the exit code; each panel module mon_<name>.py has collect(ctx) returning its data dict (or raising for unsupported); a missing module is state absent. Flags: --root DIR, --panel NAME (repeatable), --json, --once, --ansi, --interval S, --count N, --timeout S, --store PATH, --url URL, --key-file PATH, --from-snapshot FILE. Exit 0 shown, 1 an alert is shown (SP-v4yih547), 2 a bad argument. kb panel data: roots [{root, articles, facts {TAG: n}}], gaps, conflicts, refreshed, census, eval {state, when} or null, index_age_s or null. Measured 2026-10-18: rag.py --json audit takes about 3.2 s warm, so the kb panel at --timeout 0.2 times out. No outside facts needed beyond the research story's (2). Layout of the kb panel (operator's spec): roots (articles per root) · facts by tag (DOC CODE DER COMMUNITY UNK DECISION) · open gaps, conflicts · refresh (last refresh date, census tag, eval passed/total with time, pack index age).
